title: Batwing Dress, Cut Away
concept: A sharp silhouette softened by layering, material contrast, and sustainable experimentation.
description: This look is an original design developed for the Terra 360 collection, conceived around a sculpted silhouette and a layered cut-away construction. The outer dress is built in a scuba-like material with a close-fitting shape, long sleeves, a high neck, and strong winged shoulders that define its dramatic upper structure. A diagonal opening at the left waist reveals an underlying skirt panel in translucent bio-leather, connecting the garment to the collection’s focus on sustainability and material experimentation.

construction.fit: Close-fitting through the body with a long, narrow silhouette. The dress remains structured and controlled, while the under-skirt follows a fitted pencil shape.
construction.collar: High turtleneck collar with a clean, close fit around the neck. The neckline reinforces the sharp and elongated look of the garment.
construction.seams: The construction is defined by shaped seam lines and an asymmetric cut-away opening from the left waist downward. Visible topstitching remains minimal.
construction.fabric: The outer layer is interpreted in a scuba-like fabric with a smooth, compact structure. The underlying skirt is developed in a translucent bio-leather inspired by natural material experimentation.
construction.volume: The volume is slim and body-skimming, with emphasis placed on the sculptural shoulders. The layered opening adds depth without interrupting the overall elongated line.
